text: The player's horizontal velocity must not exceed 2.5 times WALK_SPEED (750 px/s) after a double jump unless on the floor.
rationale: In try_jump(), when _double_jump_charged is true, velocity.x is multiplied by 2.5, and there is no cap on this value, potentially allowing unintended speed boosts.

text: When the pause menu is opened, the player must not be able to move, jump, or shoot until it is closed.
rationale: The pause logic in game.gd only pauses the tree and shows the menu, but does not explicitly disable player input; if input processing continues, actions could leak through.

text: When the player releases the jump button while moving upward (velocity.y < 0), vertical velocity must be reduced to no less than 40% of its current value.
rationale: The code applies velocity.y *= 0.6 on jump release, but if this logic is bypassed or interrupted (e.g., by pausing or scene change), the full jump velocity could be retained, leading to higher-than-intended jumps.

text: The player must not be able to shoot while the shoot_timer is running (cooldown active).
rationale: The Gun.shoot() method returns false if timer.is_stopped() is false, but if this check is skipped due to input handling or state corruption, rapid-fire shooting could occur.

text: After landing on the floor, the _double_jump_charged flag must be reset to true before any mid-air jump is allowed.
rationale: The flag is set in _physics_process() when is_on_floor() is true, but if the player lands exactly on a frame where _physics_process() is skipped or delayed, the flag may not update, blocking the double jump.

text: After collecting a coin, the player's coin_collected signal must be emitted exactly once per coin.
rationale: Coin._on_body_entered() emits the signal once, but if the player re-enters the coin's Area2D due to tunneling or delayed collision exit, double emission could occur.

text: The player's camera must never allow the player to move beyond the level bounds (LEFT: -315, TOP: -250, RIGHT: 955, BOTTOM: 690) as defined in level.gd.
rationale: The camera limits are set in Level._ready(), but if the player is teleported or moved via script (e.g., knockback, debug) outside the physics update, they could exceed bounds before the camera clamps.

text: The player's vertical velocity must never exceed TERMINAL_VELOCITY (700 px/s) downward during free fall.
rationale: The code uses minf(TERMINAL_VELOCITY, velocity.y + gravity * delta), but if gravity * delta is unusually large (e.g., due to time scaling or paused frame accumulation), this clamp could fail.
